column2: Above 32 km/h: check the rules where you ride. %1$s
column3: Nad 32 km/h: overte si predpisy tam, kde jazdíte. %1$s
column4: Above 32 km/h: check the regulations where you ride. %1$s

column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.
column3: Týmto sa vypne kontrola trakcie. Na mokrom alebo sypkom povrchu jazdite opatrne, kým nezistíte, ako sa kolobežka správa.
column4: This will turn off traction control. On a wet or loose surface ride carefully until you find out how the scooter behaves.

column2: Below 3 km/h, the motor can pull from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.
column3: Pri hodnote pod 3 km/h môže motor kolobežku rozbehnúť z miesta hneď, ako použijete plynovú páčku.
column4: At a value below 3 km/h the motor can set the scooter moving from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle lever.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.
column3: Týmto sa vypne rekuperácia energie, teda brzdenie motorom, takže pri zastavovaní budú viac pracovať vaše brzdy.
column4: This will turn off energy recuperation, that is, motor braking, so when stopping your brakes will work more.

column2: Caps your speed while riding, below your Top speed setting. Set back restores your previous setting.
column3: Obmedzuje vašu rýchlosť počas jazdy pod hodnotu nastavenia „Maximálna rýchlosť“. Tlačidlo „Vrátiť späť“ obnoví vaše predchádzajúce nastavenie.
column4: Limits your speed while riding below the value of the "Maximum speed" setting. The "Undo" button restores your previous setting.
